summary: A burst of seven merges started seven pipelines of main whose deploys overwrote each other; three went red and request_fix opened three issues for the flow, which the author closed. The four deploy jobs now share resource_group deploy. The burst, its timings (issue to merge about 9.5 to 10.5 minutes, issue to merge request 95 to 132 seconds) and the defect are recorded in docs/experiments.md, gotcha 0006 and the credits reading (219.38).
next: Set the process mode of the deploy resource group to oldest_first with the API
